footnotes: Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 15.8% to $6.1B in 2025. Gross margin was 14.8%, versus 14.4% a year earlier, and operating income rose 36.7% to $551M, a 9.1% margin.
Net income rose 25.3× to $277M, or $0.83 per share. Operating cash flow was $317M and free cash flow $234M, versus −$26.6M.
